english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a duration such as 一個鐘.

examples.english: I waited for you for a whole hour.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 seng4 go3 zung1

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical ringing bell.

examples.english: This bell rings as soon as you strike it.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zung1 jat1 haau1 zau6 hoeng2

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a clock when the context makes the meaning clear.

examples.english: The clock in the living room is five minutes slow.
examples.traditional: 客廳嗰個鐘慢咗五分鐘。
examples.jyutping: haak3 teng1 go2 go3 zung1 maan6 zo2 ng5 fan1 zung1
